_comment: Order of the home screen. The first 6 form the glass dock. Apps that are not installed are skipped. Other installed apps are added at the end. To change it, write a copy into the launcher's private files over ADB (see the README); add a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org) there as tmdb_api_key to show 'Featured on …' titles and the Movies and TV Shows pages.
